cell type / source: patient-derived fibroblasts (PDFs) from adjacent-tumour (NT) and tumour-core (T) colorectal cancer tissue; the screen ran on one pooled sample HRS2102648 = P1 NT + P4 NT/T (donors aged 35 F and 54 M, Table S1D); 8 PDF donors in the study, ages 35-79, 0 healthy donors
design: direct-capture CRISPRi (dCas9-KRAB) and CRISPRa (dCas9-SunTag-VP64) Perturb-seq at MOI 0.5; TGFb 10 ng/mL added two days post-transduction, cells cultured three more days, FACS-sorted, 10x 3' HT v3.1 + Feature Barcode, CellPlex CMO multiplexing, 8 lanes (CRISPR_1 2 lanes, CRISPR_2 6 lanes), NovaSeq X Plus. Unperturbed PDFs +/- TGFb were profiled separately on the 10x 5' kit
n distinct perturbations (D1): library 590 CRISPRi / 265 CRISPRa / 667 union; recovered 432 / 210 / 532 after the >5-cell filter
readout: scRNA-seq (10x 3' HT v3.1) with direct sgRNA capture
units per perturbation: not stated; retention threshold is >5 cells per target. Mean cells/recovered target = 34890/432 = 80.8 (CRISPRi) and 39367/210 = 187.5 (CRISPRa) - estimate, not the median D7 asks for
target_match: n/a - no unstimulated arm exists inside the screen. The nearest unstimulated cells are unperturbed PDFs from P1/P2/P3: isogenic for P1, cross_donor for P2 and P3; 0 healthy / 8 diseased PDF donors
batch_evidence: split - the unperturbed +/- TGFb arms are 10x 5' chemistry (Table S1A) while both screen arms are 10x 3' HT v3.1 (Table S1A and STAR Methods); different samples and individuals, and different sequencing-run names (20210825-LJN-* vs P0926-*). Platform (NovaSeq X Plus), study and release date (2025-12-16) are shared
